# Phase Three Final Brainstorm — One Covenant, Distinct Studios

The Awtsmoos is One while the keilim remain many; Awtsmoos.com should make the movie language one while preserving every studio's specialty.

Canonical movie data is the interchange, not a universal renderer. The source of truth should be small, inspectable, serializable and renderer-neutral. AI generates that data. Apps project it according to explicit capabilities. Fidelity reports make handoff honest.

The proof movie is not a decorative demo. It is the acceptance suite embodied as 180 seconds: eighteen scenes, visual and dimensional variety, changing cameras, people, shapes, paths, text, charts, particles, worlds and transitions. It must travel through validators and adapters, then become actual media whose measured duration and sampled visual differences prove runtime reality.

Mobile-first authoring is a small shared dock layered over distinct app UIs, not a forced redesign of all apps. It exposes the contract, structured intent, duration/mode controls and injected-AI hooks without coupling to private DOM state.
